reviews.x: This is not the same pear bath soap I was ordering before. I was so disappointed.

My mother is nearly 80 and used to used this soap years ago because it did not bother her allergies. This time she opened the package and almost had a full asthma attack! The recipe has been changed, and this is absolutely not good soap for people with sensitivities to anything, steer clear... So sorry, Mom :-<

reviews.t: Best soap for people with allergies to perfume soaps.
reviews.x: I've been using this product for years. I'm allergic to a lot of perfumed soaps, and they break me out. Recently I was unable to find this soap in my city, so I was so happy to learned that I can get it here on Amazon.

This is NOT awful, like the first lot (with new maker) which I bought a few years ago and threw away.  This edition has a pleasant fragrance which is only slightly medicinal.  I'll keep and use it, but will be forever nostalgic for the original Pears scent and color. Why can't it be made in the original formula? Did the new manufacturer somehow not get the specifications?  Or does the new manufacturer not want to spend enough money to make it right? This sadly diminished product is usable, but c

The soap cleans and lathers very well. However, I do not like the scent. It has a medicinal smell. I was expecting a more sweet peach smell. The scent doesn't linger too long on your skin, so I will use it until it's gone. However, I wouldn't buy anymore.

I got the Pear's Glycerin soap thinking it would leave less of a residual scum on my skin, and would work well for my sensitive skin.  So far, I've noticed that it leaves a little less scum, however, there are some negatives for me.  For example I didn't realize the strong "medicine like" scent it had.  Very unpleasant.  It also does not last as long as a good bar of soap.  Will try a different brand next time.

reviews.t: This is a great product fir a great price!
reviews.x: I can no longer find Pears soap in the stores, so I turned to Amazon and found this great deal. Perfect for sensitive skin, Pears smells great and will it not dry out your skin. In bulk it’s only $1.50 / bar, so that also makes it cheaper than most soaps!
Love the soap. Received couple in a basket as a gift and been using it since. Even my husband loves it and won’t use his “ guy” soap anymore. Lathers well, feels good, nice to the skin
my husband really likes this soap because it rinses so easily without that silicone type feel. Smells really good without the typical soap or floral scent but something more spice like

reviews.t: Good for combination oily and dry skin. Lasts longer than 100% glycerin soaps.
reviews.x: The scent isn’t pretty, it’s more like absence of scent. For shower this soap works well, but I use 100% glycerin soap for facial cleansing because it’s more gentle on skin.

reviews.t: Love this soap, but you can get it cheaper
reviews.x: You can buy Pears at Dollar Tree for one dollar each. We got this because it's more convenient than going to the store. Great soap, gentle with no added fragrance.

reviews.t: Be careful whom you order from.
reviews.x: Historically, the product has been fine. It's just that I only got 2 of the 12 bars that I ordered. I had to return those to get my refund.

reviews.t: Such a unique and time rested soap
reviews.x: I love this soap. The look, the smell, takes me back to childhood and it leaves the skin feeling soft. The fragrance last hours
Longer lasting, gentler, and much cheaper alternative to Neutrogena bars!
Facial care,pleasant scent ,non drying to skin

reviews.t: Beats other transparent soaps without using animal ingredients.
reviews.x: The Pears brand has existed for quite some time, being better-known in Great Britain and Europe than in the United States. I use it for hand washing at my kitchen and bathroom sinks. I do not bathe with it only because I like something a little more luxe on my face and body. In my household a single bar lasts for nearly two months without turning to mush! It contains no animal ingredients such as tallow. It has a slightly medicinal scent which I happen to like, but if you do not, rest assured th

Was looking for a soap to use on my face that doesn't dry out my skin or doesn't get too oily. This soap is perfect! It cleans well without drying my skin, is non irritating, and leaves my skin soft and smooth, no tackiness or oilyness. The scent is nothing special, doesn't bother me though. Finally found the perfect soap for my face, couldn't be happier!

Wow!! We were very disappointed in this soap.  It smells horrible, like a bad cleaning product.  So much so that we were afraid to use it on our faces and in the shower.  I can't imagine what is in it that would make it smell that bad.  I guess we will be throwing out the 12 bars of soap.  It seems like there is little quality control any more.

reviews.t: I love glycerin  in bars but
reviews.x: I truly enjoyed this soap however it does feel like it strips all of the oils from your skin it is not moisturizing at all. He does his job as it just plain soap that you can use and sensitive skin and even your face however make sure to moisturize because this is not Moisturizing bar soap at all

reviews.t: I can buy these at the “Dollar Tree” for $1 per bar.
reviews.x: This soap was purchased to replace my Dial Glycerin bars which are now unavailable. They are not quite as gentle on my skin as the Dial bar but they are pretty good and I’m just glad I found these. Look around and find the best price as Amazon has many sellers of this product.

have used this soap since i was a baby due to sensitive skin and severe eczema issues. it still cleans my skin while being gentle and smelling great as soap is supposed to i guess. i'd recommend this soap for anyone with sensitive skin who wants to move away from bottled soap

reviews.t: Smaller bars for more expensive prices
reviews.x: Bar size have been immensely reduced and price has gone up . Also the soap doesn’t lather as much anymore. Not sure what happened.  Maybe over diluted save themselves some money. It has also lost its scent . Been using this soap for years and I can tell that it has changed

I first bought this soap as the pandemic was starting. I knew there would be lots of hand washing and I wanted soap to place at every sink at home and work that would be gentle on hands. We like it so much that we now use it in the shower, too. Smells wonderful. TMI?

reviews.t: Only has a hint of the original scent, overpowered by a (new) medicinal scent.
reviews.x: I do love the transparency of this soap.  But the scent has only a hint of the original and is overpowered by a cough medicine scent.  Not enjoyable at all.  I grew up loving this soap, both the transparency and the scent, but I don’t think I’ll be repurchasing it.

I have been using this product for years, and purchased it at dollar tree. Dollar tree has increased their prices 75%, therefore I am purchasing it at Amazon, having it delivered it and not having to go out for it. It really cleans your face with no residue.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the soap as gentle and suitable for sensitive or allergy-prone skin.
Several reviewers dislike the scent, describing it as medicinal or medicine-like rather than a pleasant peach fragrance.
Some reviewers say the formula or scent has changed from the original and are disappointed.
Reviewers report the soap lathers well, lasts long, and is non-drying on the skin.
A few reviewers mention ordering or fulfillment problems, including receiving fewer bars than ordered.
